name: Kipping Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip and swing rhythmically between a hollow and an arched arch-body kip.
As your chest passes through the arch into the hollow swing, snap your hips upward and press down on the bar with straight arms.
Follow the upward hip drive with a sharp arm pull to bring your chin cleanly over the bar.
Push smoothly back away from the bar at the top to drop cleanly back into your next arched kip swing.
tips: Generate the rhythm from your shoulders and hips together rather than jerking wildly with bent knees.
Build strict pull-up strength first to protect your shoulders during dynamic kipping.
